title: Federal Paperwork Backlogs Strip DACA Recipients of Legal Status
detail: Federal paperwork backlogs are stripping DACA recipients of legal status by causing applications to lapse, effectively creating new undocumented immigrants. The administrative delays are generating significant new legal vulnerability for thousands of DACA holders who submitted timely renewal applications.

title: ICE Targets Hong Kong Exiles Despite Existing Deportation Protections
detail: ICE is reportedly targeting Hong Kong exiles living in the United States despite existing deportation protections that should cover them, raising concerns about selective enforcement and the erosion of asylum safeguards for political dissidents.
